name: turbopuffer
summary: turbopuffer is a hosted search engine that keeps all data on object storage (S3) and caches active namespaces on NVMe SSD and memory. It offers vector search (dense and sparse), BM25 full-text search, regex and filtering, aimed at large multi-tenant workloads where cost per stored document matters.
facts: Object storage as source of truth, SSD and memory cache
Dense and sparse vectors, BM25 full-text, regex, filters
Warm vector p50 14 ms on 10M docs (vendor-reported)
Anthropic, Notion, Linear, Atlassian, Ramp (per site)
goodFor: Many namespaces, e.g. one per user or tenant
Large corpora where storage cost dominates
watchOut: Cold queries are much slower (p90 ~1.2 s on 1M docs, vendor-reported)
Closed source and hosted only, no self-host outside BYOC
Storage engine v3 redesign announced Sept 2026
